purpose: prospective directional source-displacement development audit of two frozen 29-source 5 Hz operators
role: development_only; cannot be presented as independent confirmation after results are inspected
generation: 12 new FD records; original 401x401x94 velocity, 40 m grid, 5 Hz, 0-2 s, dt 0.002 s, same 25 receivers, six zero-Dirichlet faces
metrics: at each fixed true source: full 25x1001 relative waveform L2, active-sample relative L2 where |FD| >= 5% global FD peak, model/FD peak ratio; for each anchor-offset pair: finite waveform-change relative L2 and cosine, no fitted time shift or gain; report nearest training-source distance
interpretation: directional paired descriptive comparison, two training anchors only; fixed magnitude and origin time; all events and failures retained; no localization accuracy, independence, UQ, or statistical inference claimed
